Verification Checklist

1. Run Install_ZE2_ModLoader.bat successfully.
2. Launch Zombie Estate 2.exe.
3. Confirm BepInEx\LogOutput.log contains:
   - Loading [ZE2 ModLoader 2.4.1]
   - Loading [ZE2 BepInEx Parity Bridge 0.1.0]
   - ZE2 BepInEx Parity Bridge installed.
   - Legacy bridge methods resolved.
   - Legacy sprite merge initialization invoked.
4. Confirm the main menu has a Mods entry.
5. Confirm Data\Levels, Data\Guns, and Data\Bullets are not filled with mod files after startup.

If loader does not start:
- Ensure Zombie Estate 2.real.exe exists beside Zombie Estate 2.exe.
- Ensure BepInEx\core exists.
- Ensure BepInEx\plugins\ZE2.ModLoader.dll exists.
- Ensure BepInEx\plugins\ZE2.BepInExParityBridge.dll exists.
- Ensure BepInEx\plugins\ZE2.LegacySpriteBridge\ZE2ModLoader.dll exists.
